summary: Phase 11 (offline evidence & sync) tested on web preview 390x844 for installer web. Backend: 9/9 new Phase 11 tests pass (test_p11_offline_evidence.py); regression suite 191 passed / 4 skipped / 9 errors (all 9 errors are the known /tmp/p419977.pdf env issue in test_p7_pdf_cleanup_merge.py). captured_at is stored exactly as sent (ISO past), server_received_at is separate; same client_id retry returns the same file id (no duplicate doc); installer2 posting to installer1's NC -> 403; soft-deleted project -> 404; approved NC rejects new uploads -> 409 (verified by waiting for AI assessment to settle before employee /review approve); DELETE /api/evidence/{fid} works on draft and 400 on non-draft; evidence.discarded audit entry visible via GET /api/admin/activity?kind=deletion; employee can upload to any NC; installer blocked from /admin/activity. Frontend: cached job reopens offline via SPA navigation and renders content; sync-bar shows '1 PENDING UPLOAD · OFFLINE, WILL SEND WHEN CONNECTED' with queued-status 'PENDING UPLOAD' while route is aborted; after unroute + sync-now-button the bar clears and server has the file; logout-warning-sheet with logout-sync-first and logout-force-button appears when unsynced items exist; after force logout + relogin as same installer the profile-queue-status still reads '1 item(s) waiting to sync · tap to retry' (persistence) and installer2 logging in sees empty sync-bar/queue (user isolation).

ui_bugs.issue: When navigating (while offline) to a job that was never opened online, the screen shows a generic 'FAILED TO LOAD JOB DATA / RETRY' error block instead of the specific message 'Not available offline. Open this job once while connected.' thrown by offlineCache.ts. The thrown Error.message appears to be swallowed/replaced by a generic fallback. Please surface e.message (or detect the offline sentinel) so installers understand why the job is empty. Reference: /app/frontend/src/offlineCache.ts:34 and the job detail screen's error renderer.

action_items: Verify that project/[id] renders the exact offline-cache error message ('Not available offline. Open this job once while connected.') instead of the generic 'FAILED TO LOAD JOB DATA' when offlineCache throws for a never-opened job. Likely a one-line fix in the ErrorBlock message prop on the job screen.

Device-only (NOT tested on web, re-report after native build): native camera photo+GPS stamping, airplane-mode queueing, backgrounding/foreground AppState rescue, Picture-in-Picture video, and gallery EXIF date parsing on iOS/Android.
critical_code_review_comments: queue.tsx correctly scopes items by userId and only hides (not deletes) other users' items on login; discard requires an armed two-tap and never deletes approved/submitted (those come from server, not queue).
upload path uses client_id for idempotency; backend returns existing file doc when same client_id+nc_id posts again (server.py L746-750).
offlineCache.ts correctly drops cache on 403/404 (reassigned NC / deleted project) and never serves data for keys the user has not opened online.
SyncBar shows 'OFFLINE, WILL SEND WHEN CONNECTED' when an item's error is 'Waiting for connection' and switches to red 'RETRY' on failed items.

server.py L751 raises 409 'This NC is already approved' before storing - this check is NOT subject to the client_id idempotent shortcut (dup check only matches existing docs for the same nc_id). Good: a retry after approval still returns the originally stored file.

success_rate.backend: 100% of Phase 11 (9/9); regression unchanged (191/200 passed, 9 pre-existing env errors)
success_rate.frontend: ~90% - 5/6 scenarios green; 1 minor UX fallback-message issue on never-opened offline job

seed_data_creation: Created several short-lived TEST-P11-*, TEST-P11DEL-*, TEST-P11APR-* projects via POST /api/projects as employee and cleaned them up (soft-deleted at end). The TEST-P11APR-1792502179 project was approved and then soft-deleted; nothing points at real EF-* projects.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 11 offline/sync is production-ready except for the generic offline-error-message fallback on project/[id]. Playwright file /app/tests/frontend_p11_offline.py has the full flow (login, open+cache, go-offline+re-open via SPA, abort evidence route to queue pending, sync-now, logout warning sheet, user isolation, same-user persistence). Reload-based offline testing does NOT work for Expo web preview because set_offline blocks the Metro JS bundle; use SPA (expo-router) navigation after going offline instead. Backend test file test_p11_offline_evidence.py waits up to 2 minutes for the AI assessment to leave 'assessing' before approving an NC.
rca_of_issue: project/[id] offline fallback: offlineCache.ts throws `new Error('Not available offline. Open this job once while connected.')` when a cache miss happens while fetcher threw a non-HTTP error. The job screen's query-error branch appears to render a generic 'FAILED TO LOAD JOB DATA' block instead of e.message. Fix: pass error.message to the ErrorBlock on the job screen (or detect error.message.startsWith('Not available offline') and show the dedicated empty-state).
